controles.affirmation: L'IRS reclame un redressement d'environ 2,1 Mds $ plus 418 M$ de penalites pour le seul exercice 2014, interets en sus, a la suite d'un audit 2013-2015.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 15 : "Following an Internal Revenue Service ("IRS") audit for the 2013 to 2015 fiscal years, we were unable to resolve underpayments of tax that the IRS proposed ... The IRS asserts an underpayment of tax of approximately $2.1 billion plus $418 million in penalties for fiscal year 2014. Both amounts are subject to interest, with interest of approximately $2.3 billion accruing through June 30, 2026."
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. L'ATT sous-estime plutot le sujet : les interets courus sont chiffres a environ 2,3 Mds $ au 30 juin 2026, montant superieur au redressement lui-meme, et meritent d'etre cites.

controles.affirmation: L'IRS soutient qu'une reorganisation de la structure du groupe a genere environ 6,0 Mds $ de distributions imposables.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Those amounts relate primarily to a series of reorganizations that we undertook in 2014 ... The IRS asserts that these transactions resulted in taxable distributions of approximately $6.0 billion."

controles.affirmation: Yum conteste et le litige se poursuit devant la Tax Court des Etats-Unis depuis juin 2025, sans resolution attendue sous douze mois.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "We disagree with the IRS's position and are contesting that position vigorously. On June 4, 2025, we filed a petition in the United States Tax Court ... The IRS filed its Answer on September 12, 2025. The litigation is ongoing. The Company does not expect resolution of this matter within twelve months"
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Formulation a resserrer : c'est Yum qui conteste la position de l'IRS (petition du 4 juin 2025), l'ATT ecrit "L'IRS conteste un audit fiscal 2013-2015", ce qui inverse les roles.

controles.affirmation: 11,5 Mds $ de dette totale hors revolving, 96% a taux fixe, objectif de levier net ~4,0x EBITDA, notations BB+ (S&P) / Ba2 (Moody's), sous le seuil investment grade.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "approximately 96%, including the impact of interest rate swaps, of our $11.5 billion of total debt outstanding, excluding the Revolving Facility balance, finance leases and debt issuance costs and discounts, is fixed with an effective overall interest rate of approximately 4.5% ... we expect to maintain our net leverage ratio at approximately 4.0x EBITDA over the medium term by issuing incremental debt as our business grows. We have credit ratings of BB+ (Standard & Poor's)/Ba2 (Moody's)."

controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres negatifs de 7 107 M$ au 30 juin 2026 contre -7 325 M$ fin 2025, total de l'actif 8 682 M$, deficit accumule 6 809 M$.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Accumulated deficit ( 6,809 ) ( 7,014 ) ... Total Shareholders' Deficit ( 7,107 ) ( 7,325 ) Total Liabilities and Shareholders' Deficit $ 8,682 $ 8,197"

controles.affirmation: Deux accords definitifs signes en juin 2026 pour ceder Pizza Hut ; produit net attendu d'environ 2,3 Mds $ apres impots et frais ; complement de prix eventuel de 75 M$ payable par LongRange Capital d'ici 2030 ; cloture soumise a des approbations reglementaires et non achevee a la date du 10-Q.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 3 : "On June 16, 2026, we entered into definitive agreements to sell Pizza Hut in two separate transactions ... We anticipate both transactions will close in August 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of required regulatory approvals. Across the two transactions, we expect to receive approximately $ 2.3 billion of net proceeds after taxes, closing adjustments and transaction-contingent fees. Additionally, YUM has the opportunity to receive an earn-out from LongRange Capital of $ 75 million by 2030."

controles.affirmation: Redevances de franchise percues en Chine continentale : 92 M$ au T2 2026 ; Yum China restera master franchisee.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "China Franchise revenues 73 - 18 - 92" ; "Pizza Hut in Mainland China will be acquired by Yum China Holdings, Inc., which will remain YUM's master franchisee for KFC and Taco Bell in Mainland China."

controles.affirmation: Yum! Brands "ne detient pas le capital" de Yum China Holdings.
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune mention de la participation de YUM au capital de Yum China dans le 10-Q T2 2026 cite en source ; le document indique seulement que Yum China "will remain YUM's master franchisee for KFC and Taco Bell in Mainland China".
controles.correction_proposee: Fait exact par ailleurs (scission de 2016) mais non etabli par la source citee : soit citer le 10-K FY2025 ou le document de scission, soit reformuler en "exploite par une societe cotee distincte, Yum China Holdings, dont YUM ne percoit que des redevances de franchise".

controles.affirmation: "Pizza Hut, le segment le plus faible du portefeuille" ; "Pizza Hut est de loin la plus petite des quatre divisions en chiffre d'affaires trimestriel" (254 M$ contre 924 M$ pour KFC et 853 M$ pour Taco Bell).
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Quarter ended 6/30/2026 : "KFC Division Taco Bell Division Pizza Hut Division Habit Burger & Grill Division Total ... $ 924 $ 853 $ 254 $ 139 $ 2,169" ; resultats : "Division Operating Profit (Loss) $ 410 $ 311 $ 70 $ ( 4 ) $ 787" (YTD : $ 793 $ 591 $ 135 $ ( 11 ))
controles.correction_proposee: La quatrieme division, Habit Burger & Grill, realise 139 M$ de chiffre d'affaires au T2 2026, soit MOINS que Pizza Hut (254 M$), et affiche un resultat operationnel negatif (-4 M$ au T2, -11 M$ au S1) la ou Pizza Hut degage +70 M$ au T2 et +135 M$ au S1. Pizza Hut est la troisieme division sur quatre en chiffre d'affaires et la troisieme en resultat operationnel, pas "de loin la plus petite" ni "le segment le plus faible du portefeuille". Reecrire : "Pizza Hut est la troisieme des quatre divisions en chiffre d'affaires trimestriel (254 M$ contre 924 M$ pour KFC et 853 M$ pour Taco Bell), et sa contribution au resultat operationnel recule de 155 a 135 M$ sur le semestre."
